name: 海洋II MUD
english_description: A GitHub mirror of the same 'Ocean II' codebase already preserved in this project as haiyang2 -- its own README literally identifies it as "海洋II MUD" (Ocean/Haiyang II), and its 141-entry domain directory list (annan, baituo, beihai, wudang, emei, kunlun, ...) is byte-for-byte identical, in the same order, to haiyang2's. No separate build was produced; see haiyang2 for the live, playable instance and its full fix catalog.
